title: Unarmed Minuteman III ICBM test launched from Vandenberg
detail: An unarmed Minuteman III was test-launched late on Tuesday 3 March from Vandenberg; Air Force Times reported it carried multiple reentry vehicles. Such tests normally target the Reagan Test Site at Kwajalein Atoll, though the headline does not confirm the impact area.
agency: US Air Force Global Strike Command
attribution: Headline only; event date is the Tuesday before the 4 March 2026 article

title: Marshall Islands declares state of economic emergency over fuel crisis
detail: The RMI government declared a 90-day economic emergency as fuel prices surged in the wider Middle East crisis (RNZ linked it to the Iran war); RNZ also reported government offices closing at 3pm to save fuel.

title: Finance minister warns RMI may run out of fuel within two months
detail: The RMI finance minister was reported as warning the country could run out of fuel within two months amid the Middle East conflict.
attribution: Headline only; finance minister's claim as reported by Sputnik

title: Second 2026 Minuteman III test launch from Vandenberg
detail: An unarmed Minuteman III was scheduled for and launched early on Wednesday from Vandenberg, per KEYT; Kwajalein's Reagan Test Site is the usual target area, not confirmed in the headline.
agency: US Air Force Global Strike Command
attribution: Headline only; event date is the Wednesday after the 19 May 2026 article

title: RMI tells Pacific ministers of emergency over fuel price shock
detail: The RMI finance minister told a meeting of Pacific ministers that the country had declared a state of emergency because of the fuel price shock.

title: Marshall Islands criticises Chinese missile test in Pacific
detail: AFP reported that the Marshall Islands, scarred by US nuclear testing, criticised a Chinese missile launch into the Pacific; National Indigenous Times described RMI as talking tough to Beijing over it.

title: President sets nuclear justice and climate resilience as priorities
detail: PINA reported that nuclear justice and climate resilience topped the RMI president's agenda in an address to the Nitijela (parliament).

title: US Embassy Majuro issues health alert
detail: The US Embassy in Majuro issued a health alert for the Marshall Islands on 27 August 2026; the subject of the alert was not retrieved.
